hint.text:
dominion – Herrschaftsgebiet, Vorherrschaft
In diesem Fall handelt es sich um einen Eigennamen: Im Britischen Empire war ein „Dominion“ eine selbstverwaltete Kolonie mit eigener innerer Regierung.

hint.label: dominion

atoms.b: The process of ((decolonisation)) in the British Empire began in settler colonies, where the white population demanded to ((govern)) themselves. Colonies such as Canada, South Africa, ((New_Zealand)) and Australia gained dominion status through ((peaceful_campaigning)) by the turn of the 19th century. As a ((dominion)), they remained part of the Empire under the ((Crown)) but were considered independent nations.

Asian and African people were denied self-administration and declared ((incapable)) of being self-reliant. After ((World_War_II)), however, the UK was weakened and ((unable)) to sustain the military and political pressure necessary to hold onto its colonies. India was the first extractive colony to gain independence in 1947. It was followed by many others that ((insisted)) on their right to self-determination, using nationalism, political campaigns and warfare.

atoms.a: India gained independence as the first non-settler colony in 1947.

commonwealth – Gemeinwesen
Im Deutschen wird das „Commonwealth of Nations“ jedoch nicht übersetzt.
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>commonwealth</lang> bedeutet Gemeinwesen. Im Deutschen wird das <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Commonwealth of Nations</lang> jedoch nicht übersetzt.
hint.label: commonwealth

atoms.text: In 1931, the Statute of Westminster established “The Commonwealth of Nations”. The Commonwealth was created to accommodate the changing situation in the Empire and further defined the position of dominions. After more colonies gained independence, Ghana and India were the first to voluntarily join the organisation in the 1950s. Through the organisation, many of the former British colonies keep ties to the United Kingdom.
atoms.sound: In 1931, the Statute of Westminster established “The Commonwealth of Nations”. The Commonwealth was created to accommodate the changing situation in the Empire and further defined the “white” dominions position in it. After more colonies gained independence, Ghana and India were the first to voluntarily join the organisation in the 1950s. Through the organisation, many of the former British colonies keep ties to the United Kingdom.

atoms.text: Today, the Commonwealth is made up of 56 independent nations, most of which accept the British monarch as head of state, although some such as India are republics. The Harare Commonwealth Declaration 1991 lays down the fundamental principles of the organisation: democracy, law, human rights, women's emancipation, fighting poverty, social justice and free trade. Overall, the organisation supports cultural exchange and trade agreements between its members.
